request: We started with what I spent in October, then you broke that month down and groceries were the biggest slice. Keep groceries and stretch it over the whole of 2025: draw it as a line per month.

plan.title: Grocery spending per month
plan.question: spending on Groceries per month of 2025, one row per month, ordered, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and total_eur

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Groceries'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

months on x with monthShort, euros on y

request: We looked at December, then at November on its own. Put the two months side by side per category now.

plan.title: This month against last month
plan.question: spending of December 2025 and of November 2025 per category, one row per category and period, the period named 'This month' or 'Last month', the six largest categories by total over both months, columns topic, period and total_eur

sql:
SELECT category AS topic,
       CASE WHEN booked_on >= '2025-12-01' THEN 'This month' ELSE 'Last month' END AS period,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND category IN ('Groceries', 'Cash', 'Transport', 'Shopping', 'Dining', 'Housing')
GROUP BY topic, period
ORDER BY topic, period

the columns are the category, the period and the euro figure, the figure last

the shape is bar_grouped, so barY carries layout: group()
the columns are topic, period and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
the period column is never given to a channel, so the two months are drawn on top of each other
no color channel and no legend, so nothing tells this month from last month

request: Wir hatten die aufsummierte Kurve und die Monatslinie. Jetzt bitte pro Monat 2025, wie viel mehr oder weniger ich als im Monat davor ausgegeben habe.

plan.title: Veraenderung zum Vormonat
plan.question: for each month of 2025 the difference between what was spent in it and what was spent the month before, signed so that a cheaper month is negative, one row per month, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and change_eur

sql:
SELECT month, change_eur
FROM (
  SELECT month, ROUND(total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS change_eur
  FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, -SUM(amount) AS total
    FROM transaction_view
    WHERE amount < 0
    GROUP BY month
  )
)
WHERE change_eur IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month

the request is German, so language de
die Turns davor zeigten die Monatssummen, dieser fragt nach der Differenz zwischen ihnen
eine Zahl pro Monat und keine zweite Dimension, also ein Balken pro Monat
mehr oder weniger ist ein Vorzeichen, also bleibt die Zahl signiert
die Spalten sind der Monat und die signierte Differenz, der Betrag zuletzt
reasoning_code:
the shape is bar, so the mark is barY
the columns are month and change_eur, and change_eur holds the numbers
the grid is put on the month axis instead of on the euro axis
so the euro axis has nothing to measure against and the months carry lines that mean nothing
